notes: My own solve: the 8 Hz beat puts f_B at 328 Hz or 312 Hz. Reducing the tension in A lowers f_A below 320 Hz. With f_B = 328 the gap 328 − f_A widens, so the beat would rise; with f_B = 312 the gap f_A − 312 narrows, and f_A = 316 Hz gives exactly the observed 4 Hz. So f_B = 312 Hz, option 2, which is the solution's answer. Every step equation is true as printed (I checked |f_A(new) − 328| > 8 and |f_A(new) − 312| < 8 numerically for f_A(new) = 319 and 316 Hz). The common_mistakes entry names option 4 (328 Hz), which is the genuine trap here. Difficulty medium and mistake_type_hint concept are both reasonable; prose is literal throughout.
